selection_policy: Every application in every selected scope category is returned deterministically; no vector or LLM filtering is allowed.
authorities: Kansas City Board of Public Utilities
notes: The UG publishes forms and department workflows rather than one enumerable self-service catalog. EstatePermit normalizes the official workflows without treating semantic retrieval as an applicability decision. State/federal permits and permits issued by separate municipalities in Wyandotte County are outside the Kansas City, Kansas jurisdiction pack.
